subject.title: fix(signal): add timeouts to container REST requests

question: Should the existing Signal container request timeout intentionally bound response-body transfer as well as connection and headers?
rationale: The patch is correct, but merging it deliberately changes timeout semantics for slow yet valid response bodies, requiring maintainer ownership of the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Use a complete-operation deadline
options.body: Merge this patch so the existing timeout bounds connection, headers, and bounded response-body consumption, preventing indefinite Signal operations.

options.title: Define separate body timing
options.body: Pause the PR and introduce a separately documented body deadline only if valid slow transfers must outlive the existing request timeout.

recommendation.title: Use a complete-operation deadline
recommendation.body: Merge this patch so the existing timeout bounds connection, headers, and bounded response-body consumption, preventing indefinite Signal operations.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and reviewed the available history boundary for this implementation and are the best available owner for accepting the compatibility tradeoff.
